caption: The drawing features a single wooden chair with a simple, rectangular frame in shades of yellowish-brown, giving it a light wood appearance. The legs are thick and straight, with horizontal supports connecting each leg at the base. The seat of the chair appears to be woven from a material in a slightly darker brown color, arranged in a diagonal pattern. The backrest consists of two horizontal slats, also wood-toned, and between these slats, resting on the lower one, is a small, dark blue book with a partially visible light purple bookmark or strap hanging from one side. The background is plain and off-white, with no other objects or details present.
title: Church Chair
